messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — we need final decisions on the observability launch knobs today: dashboards slices, tracing hook defaults, per-tenant cost breakdown UI, and error analytics MVP. Customers (AcmeHealth + FinTrack) are asking for per-tenant cost and trace linking.
Arjun (Eng): +1. Can we keep scope tight: dashboard templates (3), tracing hooks (basic span tags + sampling policy), cost breakdown (org & route), error analytics (top-K error types).
Priya (SRE): Ops constraint: sampling defaults matter — high sampling will blow egress. Recommend default sample rate 1% with ability to escalate to 10% for canary windows.
Ben (Data): For per-tenant cost, we can ship aggregated buckets first: total tokens, inference time, and model unit cost. Full per-span attribution requires schema work (adds ~2 sprints).
Zoe (Design): I can ship two dashboard templates: "Cost Hotspots" and "Errors by Route". Need examples of fields for cost tiles from Ben.
Maya (PM): Good. Decision proposal: MVP-1 = dashboards (2 templates), tracing hooks (span tag + sample policy UI), cost breakdown (aggregate per-tenant monthly + route), error analytics (top error types + sample traces). Everything behind feature flags. Agree? @Arjun @Priya
Arjun (Eng): Agree if we keep trace retention short for sample traces. Implementation notes: use existing trace pipeline, add hook to tag requests with tenant_id; requires adding attribute to kv-cache layer (small change).
Priya (SRE): One operational ask: default quota for per-tenant trace escalation should be rate-limited and require approval. We can't auto-open to 10% for all tenants.
Ben (Data): For billing alignment, we'll add a cost multiplier column (model_unit_cost) so Console tiles match invoices. I'll produce a mapping doc by EOD.
Zoe (Design): UX ask: surface a 'cost confidence' pill when per-tenant attribution is partial. I mocked it, will post images in the thread.
Maya (PM): Launch criteria checklist (draft): \n- Dashboards: templates rendered with sample data \n- Tracing hooks: tenant_id tagging & default sample rate 1% \n- Cost: aggregated per-tenant monthly and route, model_unit_cost column present \n- Errors: top-10 error types + ability to view a sampled trace \n- Feature flag gating + rollout plan to top 10 customers \n(need :thumbsup: from Eng/SRE/Data/Design)
Arjun (Eng): :thumbsup: from Eng. One caveat: A/B rollout needs a fallback route to reduce sampling automatically if we hit an outage.
Priya (SRE): :thumbsup: from SRE. Add alerting: if trace-ingress egress > 75% of quota, auto-throttle and notify oncall.
Ben (Data): :thumbsup: will deliver mapping and sample-export schema. I can also mock the billing-exactness delta (<5%) for launch.
Zoe (Design): :thumbsup: I'll attach final mocks by tomorrow morning.
Maya (PM): Action items: \n- Arjun: tenant_id tag PR + sample policy UI (owner) — due in 3 days.\n- Priya: operational throttle + alerts (owner) — due in 5 days.\n- Ben: cost mapping doc + sample dataset (owner) — due EOD.\n- Zoe: final mocks + confidence pill text (owner) — due tomorrow morning.\n- Maya: roll-out canary plan & customer comms (owner) — due Friday.
Arjun (Eng): Noted. I'll open PR and link CI job; deploy-bot will post status.
deploy-bot: build/ci-pipeline #482 passed for branch feature/tenant-trace-tag (1725560200)
Maya (PM): Thanks — let's reconvene after PR review. If anything blocks, drop blockers into #eng-oncall."
